content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Hamirpur Project Associate I/ Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Hamirpur Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Associate-I/Project Associate-II positions at NIT Hamirpur is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-I/Project Associate-II posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Mechanical Engineering with first class, and must have qualified GATE or CSIR-UGC NET for Project Associate-I. Project Associate-II requires 2 years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on the specific role (Project Associate-I or II).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Hamirpur recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate roles?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to send their complete application via email to the address specified in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These are contractual positions offered by the National Institute of Technology Hamirpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
